evaluation_scope: generated-family out-of-fold rows only; auxiliaries fit only

plan.decision_rule: Report fitting and excluded-family scores on both full-phase and representative distributions, all styles and family folds. Geometry gains do not establish independent acceptance. No per-case exceptions or output overrides.
plan.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
plan.evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
plan.geometry_range_contract: Reconstruct public coordinates and ranges in integer logic units. Compare squared center distance with squared attack range plus target radius. No attacker radius in reach. Continuous edge-gap feature retains square root; binary reach avoids float boundary drift.
plan.loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
plan.purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
plan.scope: Training-only relational-feature diagnostic. Add48per-tower features from visible positions/team/HP/kind and frozen actor-encoder public card stats plus fixed public arena tower fixtures. Features describe geometric reach and public damage magnitude, not attack readiness or hidden targets. No projectile coverage claim. Same tree configuration, fixed50/50loss, seed and family folds as mixed-tree baseline. No model promotion.
